data.long_meaning: Tejal is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for girls which means radiant, shining, auspicious. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'tejas' which means radiance or brightness. data.spiritual_significance: Tejal is deeply connected to the spiritual world. The name is derived from Tejas, which symbolizes inner radiance and brightness. The goddess Tejaswini embodies this spiritual quality and is revered as a symbol of purity, grace, and knowledge. Thus, bearing the name Tejal is a reminder for every individual to strive towards inner radiance and spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Tejal was an Apsara or celestial nymph who was one of the twelve Aditya Kumaris. She was the goddess of radiance, beauty, and grace. She was the consort of Aditya, the Sun God, and is said to have been born from the tears of Sage Vashista when he wept for the death of his son, the Moon God's son Andhaka.
Tejasi (Tejal) was a queen in the Satavahana Dynasty of ancient India, who ruled between 120 CE and 130 CE. She is known for her patronage of Buddhism, and her coins bear the image of the Buddha.
